text:
alex: perf-bot flagged the nightly E2E longseq suite — throughput down ~25% vs baseline, failing the throughput gate. dashboard: https://dash.local/longseq/1898765432
perf-bot: nightly-e2e/longseq FAILED: throughput (observed=540 rps, threshold=750 rps). p95 latency within limits.
sam: looking into it. which commit shipped?
alex: last good run was commit 0a1b2c3 (2026-03-14). current run used 1f2e3d4 (PR #4122 merged yesterday). suspect allocator/cache change.
maria: can you drop the run artifacts link so I can pull traces?
alex: artifacts: s3://redwood-e2e/artifacts/1898765432 — quick log snippet below:
```
throughput=540 rps
worker-0 mem=12.3GB, worker-1 mem=12.1GB
kv_cache_hits=0
startup_time=24.2s
```
sam: kv_cache_hits=0 stands out. PR #4122 touched cache key encoding — could be a seed mismatch.
jen: I can kick a rerun with KV persist enabled or revert to the previous image tag. who can trigger the job?
alex: @ci-bot can you rerun with ENABLE_KV_PERSIST=true?
ci-bot: manual rerun queued: nightly-e2e/longseq @commit 1f2e3d4 env={ENABLE_KV_PERSIST=true}. job id=98765.
sam: if rerun fails, let's bisect 0a1b2c3..1f2e3d4. I'll prep a bisect script.
maria: I can try a local repro to reduce noise. quick command I used:
```
./tools/e2e_run.sh --suite longseq --commit 1f2e3d4 --seq-length 32 --repeats 3
```
that reproduced a smaller delta locally.
jen: if we bisect, allocate a smaller GPU node to reduce variance. I'll claim infra slot.
alex: plan sounds good. rerun first, then bisect if needed.
ci-bot: rerun finished: throughput=760 rps (baseline ~780 rps). gate PASSED. job id=98765.
sam: rerun passed with ENABLE_KV_PERSIST=true — points to cache seeding race during startup in the default config.
maria: creating a follow-up bug and a dedicated regression test for kv cache persistence across restarts. assigning to @sam and @jen.
alex: thanks everyone. adding to release notes as a follow-up: "fix: ensure kv cache seed on longseq deployments". marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
